parameters.query:
WITH it AS (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(i || jsonb_build_object('sku_id', COALESCE(m.tiktok_sku_id, 'gia-' || (i->>'seller_sku')))) AS items
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($3::jsonb) i
  LEFT JOIN sku_map m ON m.seller_sku = i->>'seller_sku'
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO gia_lap_don (order_id, buyer_user_id, status, line_items, total_amount)
  SELECT $1, COALESCE(NULLIF($6, ''), 'gia-lap-khach'), $2, (SELECT items FROM it), $4::numeric
  WHERE $5 = 'dat_don'
  ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING order_id, status
), upd AS (
  UPDATE gia_lap_don
     SET status = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), status),
         tracking_number = CASE WHEN $2 IN ('IN_TRANSIT', 'DELIVERED')
                                THEN COALESCE(tracking_number, 'VNGL' || right(order_id, 6))
                                ELSE tracking_number END,
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE order_id = $1 AND $5 <> 'dat_don'
  RETURNING order_id, status
)
SELECT order_id, status FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT order_id, status FROM upd;

parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.created_at DESC), '[]'::json) AS orders FROM (
  SELECT g.order_id, g.buyer_user_id, g.status, g.tracking_number, g.line_items AS items, g.total_amount,
         g.created_at, g.updated_at,
         (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('status', l.status, 'tracking_number', l.tracking_number,
                                                     'luc', l.changed_at) ORDER BY l.changed_at), '[]'::json)
            FROM order_status_log l WHERE l.tiktok_order_id = g.order_id) AS lich_su
  FROM gia_lap_don g
  ORDER BY g.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 50
) t;
